Elected representatives responsible to the Legislature
Nomination of official members to the Legislature
x: Provision for a written Constitution for the country was not mentioned in the Government of India Act, 1935. The demand for a constitution was accepted in principle by the British Government in what is known as the 'August Offer' of 1940, in which the British Government concurred that the framing of the new constitution should be primarily the responsibility of Indians themselves. In 1942, Sir Stafford Cripps, a member of the British cabinet, came to India with a draft proposal from the British Government on the framing of an independent constitution to be adopted after World War II.

x: Fundamental Duties came from the USSR; the Governor, PSCs and Emergency scheme came from the 1935 Act.
